headline:
Ancestry gives you the foundation.
Genesis takes you on the journey.
body: Your tree, your family's voices, their stories and recipes, in one private place.

headline: Save Grandma's voice before it's only a memory.
body: The app asks the questions out loud, records her answers and writes them into your family story. In English, Español, Français and more.

headline: Already on Ancestry? Bring your tree in two minutes.
body: Upload your GEDCOM file and everyone comes across, parents, children and spouses linked. Download it again any time.

headline: Your family history, written as a book.
body: Turn your tree, stories and recipes into a beautiful storybook to print, share or give as a gift.

headline: Don't just get a hint. See the evidence.
body: Every record match comes with the reasons for and against, plus an AI genealogist who explains what to check next.

headline: We never sell your family's data.
body: Not to advertisers, not to insurers, not to anyone. Download everything or delete it all in one click.

headline: Search the archives. No paywall.
body: World family trees, historic newspapers, national archives in Canada, the US, Europe and beyond, free to search.

headline: Become one of our founding families.
body: Free to start. Pro is $19 CAD a month. Help shape the family history app built for stories, not just names.
